description: Live US rental listings for an area and budget, no key needed. Returns at most 10 listings per call (rent, beds, baths, size, address, coordinates, photo, source link, days listed). Use a state code and a city for one market; add rent and bedroom limits to narrow it. For complete results a HousingFeed key is needed.

city.description: City name, partial match, e.g. Brooklyn.

max_beds.description: Maximum bedrooms. Same as min_beds for exactly N.

max_lat.description: North edge of a map box.

max_lng.description: East edge of a map box.

min_lat.description: South edge of a map box.

min_lng.description: West edge of a map box.

new_since_days.description: Only listings first seen in the last N days (new listings land weekly, Sunday to Tuesday UTC).

sort.description: best (default): photo and coordinates first, freshest, mixed sources.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. NY.

name: search_rentals_sample
title: Search US rental listings (free sample)
